set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

pairs = [
    ('animals', '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79181619/inputs/dataset_8b4b72ea-0eeb-4bac-8c9d-fe8981e98bc5.dat'),
    ('fungi', '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79181619/inputs/dataset_178f523f-6705-4cca-b5c3-a22f134c02e6.dat'),
]

out_path = pathlib.Path('pis_counts.tsv')
work_root = pathlib.Path('alignments')
with out_path.open('w') as out:
    out.write('group\tfile\tparsimony_informative\ttotal_sites\tpercent\n')
    for group, archive_path in pairs:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
            members = sorted(
                name for name in archive.namelist() if name.endswith('.mafft')
            )
            for member in members:
                alignment_path = work_root / group / pathlib.PurePosixPath(member).name
                alignment_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                alignment_path.write_bytes(archive.read(member))
                result = subprocess.run(
                    ['phykit', 'parsimony_informative_sites', str(alignment_path)],
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                )
                if result.returncode != 0:
                    print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
                    sys.exit(result.returncode)
                values = result.stdout.strip().split('\t')
                if len(values) != 3:
                    print('Unexpected phykit output for ' + member + ': ' + result.stdout, file=sys.stderr)
                    sys.exit(1)
                out.write('\t'.join([group, member, values[0], values[1], values[2]]) + '\n')
PY
